english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something being liable to cause misunderstanding rather than deliberately deceiving people.

exampleSentences.english: Writing the headline like that is liable to be misleading.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁樣寫個標題，好容易令人誤會嘅。
